$comment: The six sound effects, SYNTHESIZED by `npm run sfx` with the bundled ffmpeg: no API, no credits, the same bytes on every machine, cached in sfx/. A scene cues them with window.SFX = [[seconds, id, gainDb?], ...]; every cue must have something visible changing at that moment. `gain` is the effect's level in dB; narration sits at -16 LUFS on its own bus, so keep effects 12 dB or more under the voice and never on a spoken word's onset. tick = small items counting or typing; sweep = a scene change; chime = a result landing; refuse = a flaw found, a no; wait = a pause, an approval pending; pop = one thing appearing. Add an effect by adding a recipe (`source` is an ffmpeg lavfi source, `filter` an optional audio filter chain).
